exceptions.reason: Founder-authorized, time-limited acceptance of the braces stack-exhaustion advisory in the Tailwind development toolchain. No fixed braces release is available for this advisory. This record is risk acceptance, not a dependency fix or a claim that the advisory is absent.
exceptions.removal_criterion: Install a braces release that fixes GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, or complete an authorized Tailwind CSS 4 migration that removes the affected chain. Delete E-1 and prove the complete frontend npm audit --audit-level=high is clean, with frontend typecheck, coverage and build passing. If no supported fix is ready by review_by, CI must fail; a renewal requires a fresh explicit decision.
